mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, image_url, audio_url, latitude, longitude, radius, /* 动态计算当前位置到景点的距离（米） */ ST_Distance_Sphere(location, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{longitude}, ' ', #{latitude}, ')'), 4326)) AS distance FROM scenic_spots WHERE is_deleted = 0 /* 核心过滤：计算出的距离必须小于等于景点的感应半径 */ AND ST_Distance_Sphere(location, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{longitude}, ' ', #{latitude}, ')'), 4326)) <= radius ORDER BY distance ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, name, description, image_url, audio_url, latitude, longitude, radius, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM scenic_spots WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT s.id AS scenicId, s.name AS name, SUBSTRING(s.description, 1, 30) AS intro, u.phone AS lastModifier, s.updated_at AS modifyTime FROM scenic_spots s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.updated_by = u.id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scenic_spots (name, description, image_url, audio_url, latitude, longitude, location, radius, is_deleted, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{audioUrl}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{longitude}, ' ', #{latitude}, ')'), 4326), #{radius}, #{isDeleted}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
